items.title: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 Aims to Make Robots Safer, More Dexterous, and Faster Learners
items.blurb: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action (VLA) model designed to improve robots' dexterity, reliability, and learning speed, while enabling safer operation in unstructured real-world environments.

items.title: DoorDash Scales Dispatch 10x While Maintaining 99.99% Peak Availability
items.blurb: DoorDash has redesigned its real-time dispatch platform, replacing a monolithic optimization engine with a distributed architecture that separates coordination from computation.

items.title: Presentation: Learning Out Loud (Under Near-Existential Pressure)
items.blurb: Laura Savino discusses the psychological friction of AI adoption for senior engineers & architects. She explains how shifting from static expertise to learning in public lowers anxiety, accelerates tooling fluency, and prevents burnout.
